quotes: I don't want to merely use the future. I want to help build it.
If the tools don't exist for the problem I see, I would rather build the tools than lower my ambition.
Technology is interesting to me not because of what it can do today, but because of what it makes possible tomorrow.
I have never been very interested in following the path that already exists. I am more interested in understanding why it exists — and whether a better one can be built.
Build something useful. Learn from what breaks. Build again.
The best ideas rarely arrive finished. They become clear when you have the courage to build them.
I measure progress less by what I have achieved and more by what I am now capable of building.
There is always more to learn, and that is precisely what makes building worthwhile.
I don't believe in waiting until you are ready. Some things can only be learned by beginning.
Software is not just about writing code. It is about turning an idea that exists in your head into something that can exist in the world.
Curiosity starts the journey. Discipline keeps it moving. Building gives it meaning.
I want my work to outlive the moment in which it was created.
The goal is not to be the person who knows everything. It is to remain the person who is willing to learn anything.
Every difficult problem is an invitation to become capable of solving a harder one.
I would rather build something imperfect that teaches me something than wait for something perfect that teaches me nothing.
The most rewarding part of technology is not the technology itself. It is seeing an idea become real.
I am still becoming the person capable of building the things I imagine.
Somewhere between curiosity and persistence, ideas become things.
